This action serves as a pointed reminder that Valenti had previously condemned the Betamax technology as a threat to the film industry, contrasting his past opposition with the current legal battle over digital file-sharing. ", "rephrased": "Jack Valenti, who served as the president of the Motion Picture Association of America, once testified before the US Congress that the VCR was a dangerous threat to the film industry, comparing it to a serial killer. ", "rephrased": "Professional singer and spokesperson for the Recording Artists' Coalition, Sheryl Crow, argues that the technological landscape has shifted dramatically, noting that while Betamax copies suffered from inferior quality, modern digital file-sharing allows for the distribution of millions of perfect reproductions. She further points out that the US Constitution's copyright clause was originally written to promote the progress of science and useful arts by securing exclusive rights to authors and inventors, suggesting that current legal interpretations may have strayed from this original intent.", "summary": "A music industry advocate contrasts the quality limitations of past technology with modern digital distribution while emphasizing the original constitutional intent behind copyright law."}}
